PassiveDesc.Name: Change of Rules
PassiveDesc.Desc: After the unit uses a Combat Page, shuffle all copies of it back into the deck at the start of the Scene until all Combat Pages in the deck have been used. At the start of the Scene, recover all Light. After rolling a die, give all dice on the Combat Page roll value equal to its roll value.

PassiveDesc.Name: Forced Survival
PassiveDesc.Desc: At the start of the Scene, recover 5 HP and Stagger Resist.

PassiveDesc.Name: Gene Code G-0
PassiveDesc.Desc: Upon starting Combat, the ally with the least HP recovers 5 HP and Stagger Resist.

PassiveDesc.Name: Resolution
PassiveDesc.Desc: At the start of the Scene, gain 2 Haste if the unit has 4+ Poise.

PassiveDesc.Name: Backing
PassiveDesc.Desc: Upon starting Combat, before rolling dice on the first Combat Page slotted by the ally with the highest Aggro, opposing dice lose 1 power.
